name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: 0.0.38 fixed the code so newly-created federated items on a WAN-capped Direct-mode server get a working Play button, but reconciliation only ever creates and deletes items - it never updates an existing one in place - so every item already synced before the upgrade was still stuck with the old broken null-Path/Placeholder state. This adds a one-time migration (MigratedPlaceholderPathV10, same mechanism as the V4-V9 migrations before it) that rebuilds every affected existing item on the next sync so it picks up the fix. As with every prior rebuild-based migration in this plugin, item ids are unchanged but local watch progress on rebuilt items is reset - flagged here explicitly since this migration is expected to affect an entire WAN-capped library's worth of items on upgrade, not an edge case.
